description:
Be visionary 
 
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ 
 
 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   
 Job Description 
   
 Software design and development of calibration and test software for our infrared sensing systems. Also responsible for the development of production support software and systems. Participation in every phase of a project, including requirements review, software design and coding, unit testing, system integration, and sustaining engineering.
 
 Job Qualifications 
 2+ years of experience with C, C#, and/or C++ programming
 Experience developing in Visual Studio is highly desired
 Experience programming in an SQL Server environment is highly desired
 Experience testing equipment in thermal chambers is highly desired
 Understanding of embedded, multi-threaded software design and implementation is very helpful (e.g., Embedded Linux, RTEMS, etc.)
 Ability to understand both the hardware and software components of embedded systems under test
 Knowledge of hardware subsystems and common peripheral buses, including I2C, SPI, and USB
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
 Ability to set up tool chains, build and debugging environments, and utilize debugging tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and similar equipment is highly desirable
 Experience with infrared and/or visible imaging technologies, image acquisition, and image processing is desired but not required
 Experience testing high-volume products is helpful
 Ability to design software in a manner that reduces test time is highly desired
 Experience using AI tools for software development in a commercial product environment is required
 
 Education and Experience 
 BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
 Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of some or all of the educational requirements
 Work Authorization 
 Applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents
 
   
 Salary Range: 
$90,800.00-$121,100.000 
 
 The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.
 
 
 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.
 
 Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. ​
